name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: A set of official plug-in packages that connect the Cursor AI coding editor to popular developer tools and services, plus the rules for building your own.
buyer: A SaaS company — a database, monitoring, or API platform — that wants developers using Cursor to easily connect their product into their coding workflow.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools SaaS builds and maintains an official Cursor plugin to drive adoption among AI-assisted developers.
A freelance developer offers paid 'Cursor plugin development' services to SaaS companies that want one but lack the bandwidth.
A platform curates and lists third-party Cursor plugins, charging vendors a featured-placement fee.

money_ideas.idea: Contract work building custom Cursor plugins for SaaS vendors
Featured-listing fees in a curated plugin directory

steal_this: Pick a SaaS tool you already use that has no Cursor plugin, build one this weekend, and pitch it to that company as a growth channel.
